installer-gui-script.title: Traktor Kontrol S4 Driver 2.8.0 (Apple Silicon)

choice.title: S4 MK1 Audio Driver (arm64)
choice.description: arm64 CoreAudio HAL driver. Creates the “Traktor Kontrol S4 MK1” audio device and owns the S4’s USB audio interface. Required. Needs only your administrator password.

choice.title: Traktor Controller Integration (kernel extension)
choice.description: arm64 identity shim kernel extension. Without it, Traktor Pro 4 does not recognise the S4 as a controller (audio still works in other apps). Installing it requires Reduced Security and disabled kext signing, set once in recovery mode — see the Read Me.
